verdict.rationale: The official iOS App Store listing documents a real mobile app with photo upload, Advanced Voice Mode, and image generation. The docs also say ChatGPT Work tasks can be continued on the web, iOS, or Android, which confirms official apps on both platforms. Several documented capabilities (Computer Use, Goal mode, local projects, Pets controls) are tied to the desktop app, so mobile feature parity is not shown. Missing for 10: Android app documentation beyond a single passing mention, evidence of feature parity with desktop and web, independent or hands-on corroboration of mobile app quality.
